assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Lack of official precise regulatory redline and municipal utility capacity data.
assumptions.impact: Provisional boundaries and scenario calculation models are applied; final metrics require recalculation upon official data release.

assumptions.statement: Policy uncertainties regarding autonomous driving and open-source algorithm testing in public space.
assumptions.impact: Tiered admission sandboxes (L1-L3) and human-in-the-loop fallback mechanisms are established.

assumptions.statement: Varying public acceptance and consensus regarding AI technology integration in historical heritage space.
assumptions.impact: Public participation, bilingual wayfinding, and non-digital alternative service channels are provided.

assumptions.statement: Long-term operation and maintenance funding gaps for public AI infrastructure.
assumptions.impact: Multi-agent investment models, open-source governance committee, and commercial lounge revenues are leveraged.

assumptions.statement: Building status classification (retain / renovate / demolish / new) cannot be determined without official building survey data including construction year, structural type, legal status, and current use condition.
assumptions.impact: All building footprints in geometry/buildings.geojson are marked status=unknown. Building density, demolition ratio, and retention ratio are concept-only estimates pending official survey data.

assumptions.statement: All submitted boundaries and derived metrics are ready for one-click recalculation when official site boundary and key-area geometry are released.
assumptions.impact: Geometry layers and metrics are regenerable from the same pipeline; provisional values in this package will be replaced without changing design intent.

assumptions.statement: Wind corridor cooling effect is estimated as a 0.8°C ~ 1.5°C range under peak summer load based on synthetic tabletop CFD reasoning and published ventilation-corridor methodology.
assumptions.impact: The range is a design-stage estimate pending on-site micro-meteorological stations and CFD validation; it must not be cited as a measured or approved performance figure.

assumptions.statement: The Civic Value Protocol revenue-sharing mechanism is positioned as a voluntary CSR charter under the Zhongguancun pilot sandbox framework, not a statutory obligation.
assumptions.impact: The 15% fund ratio and governance rules are concept suggestions for professional teams and authorities to deepen; no investment or legal commitment is implied.

assumptions.statement: Official building survey data (retain/renovate/demolish/new classification and precise footprints) is pending; building_count and footprint are provisional counts from 63 polygons.
assumptions.impact: building_density is marked unknown until official buildable land and building survey data are provided.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines and rail station entrance coordinates are pending; road_centerline_length_m and tod_station_500m_cover are concept-level proxies.
assumptions.impact: TOD coverage uses key-area centroids as proxy; recalculate with official station data.

assumptions.statement: Land-use category boundaries (LU-001~004) follow the provisional land_use.geojson; areas match the proposal text (309.4/270.8/249.2/311.9 ha).
assumptions.impact: Land-use structure indicators remain provisional until official land-use plan is released.

assumptions.statement: Development intensity (FAR), height, and setback values are intentionally not quantified in node-level designs; they must come from the official regulatory plan.
assumptions.impact: No planning-control values are asserted on provisional geometry; design proposals remain qualitative at node level.

assumptions.statement: Roadmap responsible parties and funding sources are generic role types (lead authority + professional operations team) pending authorization; no specific government agency commitments are assumed.
assumptions.impact: Implementation roadmap reads as concept suggestions only.

assumptions.statement: green_ratio (0.311) includes all provisional green patches (355.1 ha); the plan-green alternative is 270.8 ha (LU-002). Both are disclosed in note_zh and proposal text.
assumptions.impact: Green-ratio comparisons must use the disclosed dual calibers.

assumptions.statement: green_300m_coverage (85.6%), tod_station_500m_cover (20.6%) and greenway_gap_count (15) are synthetic estimates on provisional geometry.
assumptions.impact: Indicators are baselines for field verification, not confirmed service levels.

assumptions.statement: Scenario-card counts (13), personas (6), AI landmarks (3), Proof-Mile interfaces (6) and renewal projects (6) are derived from the proposal's own ledgers and are internally consistent.
assumptions.impact: Count-based metrics are stable across bilingual versions.

assumptions.statement: Average polygon footprint of the 63 building features is about 28,620 m² (campus/district-level parcels); this is a geometry characteristic, not a per-building assertion.
assumptions.impact: Building-density and footprint magnitude should be read with this caveat.
